New original full-body Piccolo artwork, transparent PNG, portrait frame. First attached concept image is the direct gesture/expression reference: an unmistakably asymmetrical instant of taking the hit while physically shielding the space behind him; face turned upward, mouth open, torso lifted and pulled back by the impact, arms thrown wide. His nearer arm on image left reaches low and out towards us, the farther arm reaches up and back to the upper right. Use unequal elbow and wrist heights. Near boot is forward and far boot behind, wide braced step and softly bent knees. Pose the figure along a dynamic diagonal at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Match the gesture of the first reference closely in a new drawing and camera; create fresh lines. Use the second reference only for C-style black manga contour linework, controlled cel shadows, garment colors and the correctly articulated hands with distinct thumbs and fingers. Single subject Piccolo only, two antennae, purple gi, navy sash and green skin; no other characters or objects. No lighting streaks, aura, floor, backdrop or text. Both hands, hairline antennae and boots visible with margin, true transparency.
